name: Constraint-Preserving Hidden-State Embedding Family
definition: Cross-API refinement of the hidden-state embedding problem. Candidate embeddings must preserve the existing hidden/base and inheritance commuting laws and land in the physical kernel of the Time-Space native constraint algebra.
math: Emb_H,phys^R={ iota_H:E_H^R↪E | pi_E∘iota_H=j_T∘pi_H; I∘iota_H=iota_H∘I_H; iota_H(E_H^R)⊆ker(C) }. API4.3 supplies C_a|Psi_phys>=0, U ker(C)⊆ker(C), and C_read Pi_T=Pi_T C_native on admissible states. The family is defined; nonemptiness/selection of a physical iota_H remains open.

name: Dark-Matter Qualification Locus
definition: Precise internal definition of what a dark-matter realization would have to be in the current architecture. It does not assert that such a pair exists in nature.
math: DM_R:={(u_f,u_v): matched external data; u_f contains admissible hidden S3 organization; M_R(u_f)=M_R(u_v); T_H:=T_f−T_v≠0; g_f≠g_v; Ein(g_f)=κT_f; Ein(g_v)=κT_v; persistence/boundary/Q gates pass}.

name: Dark-Matter Qualification Nonemptiness
definition: Final internal existence target after the source map is typed: prove that the Dark-Matter Qualification Locus contains at least one admissible full/visible comparison state.
math: Goal: DM_R ≠ ∅ for at least one declared Resolution R and matched comparison class.

name: Dark Readout Factorization Defect
definition: Pairs of formal states identified by ordinary matter readout but distinguished by gravitational readout.

name: Hidden Persistent-Boundary Contact Set
definition: Canonical boundary-incidence object replacing the arbitrary open incidence relation. It detects whether the closure of the hidden persistent subset reaches the already-existing Persistent Boundary.
math: B_H^R := cl_E(Xi_H^R) ∩ ∂Xi. B_H^R=∅ kills the residue route at Resolution R; B_H^R≠∅ supplies the relevant boundary support.

name: Hidden Boundary-Response Form
definition: Positive response geometry on relative S2 port states after quotienting the kernel of the hidden response operator.

name: Hidden S3 to S2 Response Operator
definition: Effective S2-port operator obtained by eliminating hidden S3 interior coordinates from the continuity Laplacian.

name: Hidden S3 Multi-Port Continuity Network
definition: Candidate Mode-0-selected hidden continuity organization joining multiple localized S2 / black-hole ports within the established S3 continuity level. It is a derived subnetwork candidate, not a new dimension and not yet identified with dark matter.
math: G_H^R=(V_H,E_H,w), with multi-port hidden connectivity; active geometry remains S4 -> S3 -> S2.

name: Hidden S3 Relational-State Bundle
definition: Type-normalized bundle candidate for the time-indexed hidden S3 network organization. Its existence as a smooth admissible bundle is conditional on the declared hidden relational history.
math: π_H:E_H^R→T_H, with fiber state R_H(t)=(V_t,E_t,w_t,χ_t,H_t)_R. This types the domain of iota_H; it does not itself prove iota_H exists.

name: Hidden S3 State Embedding into Inherited State Bundle
definition: Primary open selection/existence problem after bidirectional cross-crawl: select a physical embedding from @dm_constraint_preserving_embedding_family. The family is typed; nonemptiness and a realized embedding remain open.
math: Select iota_H∈Emb_H,phys^R. Required: pi_E∘iota_H=j_T∘pi_H; I∘iota_H=iota_H∘I_H; iota_H(E_H^R)⊆ker(C).

name: Projection-Residue Survival Test
definition: Tests whether matched full and visible-only constructions remain distinguishable after boundary projection and invariant-residue bundle construction.
math: B_full^R not ~=_F B_vis^R is a sufficient field-bundle survival witness.

name: Q-Handoff Survival Theorem
definition: A hidden full-vs-visible distinction that survives as a non-isomorphic residue bundle cannot disappear by merely appending the standard Q-handoff structure, because the residue bundle is a constituent of Q.
math: B_full≄B_vis ⇒ no Q-isomorphism preserving the residue-bundle constituent can identify Q_full with Q_vis. Thus bundle-level survival implies Q-structured survival under the declared morphism category.
